fieldValues.title: What should a dream test our data against?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised in Research (Dreamtime), 2026-10-30, as a question to explore before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Archetype scenarios (srs-context's scenarios.md).
- B. Replays of real sessions.
- C. The questions people actually asked (srs-context's gold questions).
- D. Storylines across vignettes: the same story told more than once.
- E. A cold reader: can a newcomer find their way (the human-readable test).
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Which tests found real defects in srs-context's dreams so far, and which found nothing.
fieldValues.next_action: Read the last dream reports in srs-context and tally what each kind of test changed.
